description: Read the active page's visible text (up to 12000 characters; 8000 with a selector; longer text is cut and marked), optionally scoped to a selector. When the page navigated while it was read: without a selector it returns page_changed (ask again); with one — a read that waits for a selector goes on across the page's own move to the next page — the first line of the result says so and gives both addresses.
name: browser_read
